other formal: datatype 'a tree = Leaf | Node "'a tree" 'a "'a tree"

formal function definitions.size: primrec size :: "'a tree ⇒ nat" where "size Leaf = 0" | "size (Node l x r) = size l + size r + 1"
formal function definitions.height: fun height :: "'a tree ⇒ nat" where "height Leaf = 0" | "height (Node l a r) = max (height l) (height r) + 1"
formal function definitions.complete: fun complete :: "'a tree ⇒ bool" where "complete Leaf = True" | "complete (Node l x r) = (height l = height r ∧ complete l ∧ complete r)"
formal function definitions.ipl:
fun ipl :: "'a tree ⇒ nat" where
  "ipl Leaf = 0" |
  "ipl (Node l _ r) = ipl l + size l + ipl r + size r"

formal theorem statement: theorem ipl_if_complete_int: "complete t ⟹ int(ipl t) = (int(height t) - (2::nat)) * (2::nat)^(height t) + (2::nat)"
